archived_repeated_colour_panel_explorato.estimand: Species-equal mean of within-window observer-split rarity x temporal change; dimensionless. Positive = tendency toward a 50:50 white/nonwhite photo-label frequency.

full_4475_registry_primary.estimand: Species-equal mean of within-window observer-split rarity x temporal change; dimensionless. Positive = tendency toward a 50:50 white/nonwhite photo-label frequency.

limitations: Photo-region WHITE/NONWHITE labels are not genetically validated morphs or individual population censuses.
Year-to-year frequencies can reflect environment, plant turnover, migration, developmental stage, photography, or persistent individuals.
A 10-arcminute geographic cell is not necessarily a biological population.
A positive result tests symmetric convergence toward 0.5 only; cannot identify fitness-frequency dependence or exclude different equilibria.
Null is conditional temporal label exchangeability, not a population-genetic selection model.
No inference that selection is absent from a nonsignificant test.
decision: Do not extend photo temporal hypothesis with alternate thresholds or hypothetical missing outcomes; no support for symmetric convergence. Future frequency-dependent fitness tests require independently measured flower phenotypes, actual local morph abundance and morph-specific reproductive success.
